newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady with moderate enquiries.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady with moderate enquiries.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes were steady with moderate enquiries on Friday and prices were supported by cargo strength, traders said.

"The enquiry level is actually not too bad when Japan is having holidays," said one trader. But suppliers' firm quotes amid strong cargo prices, with the 380-cst fuel oil inching 50 cents up to $91.50 per tonne on Wednesday, kept some shipowners sidelined, another trader said.
Bunker 380-cst and 180-cst were quoted at $97/$98 and $104/$105 per tonne. MDO and gas oil were at around $193/$195 and $210/$213 respectively. -- Singapore Newsroom (65-870 3571)
